recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the FHIR-28217 description/definition application while preserving later FHIR-48366 semantics; no broader Goal model change is indicated.
issue_request: FHIR-28217 was Applied as Persuasive with Modification for Goal, requesting a Goal.acceptance participant element for parties accepting a goal, renaming Goal.acceptance.individual to Goal.acceptance.participant, adding PractitionerRole, CareTeam, and Organization targets, and updating the description/definition for the accepting actor.
initial_application: Commit 0d8e3756353bd8c0e93994eea043a54216ae2f37 applied the rename and requested target profiles, but left the authoritative participant definition as "The person ororganization whose acceptance/priority is being reflected" and left neighboring acceptance wording as individual-only.
additional_context: Goal is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-44978 introduced Goal.acceptance in the base resource, FHIR-48366 later added Group to Goal.acceptance.participant, and the 2020 MCC Care Plan minutes describe the original need as acceptance by a certain person or group. Quoted Zulip and Confluence full-text searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Updated source/goal/structuredefinition-Goal.xml so Goal.acceptance, Goal.acceptance.participant, Goal.acceptance.status, and Goal.acceptance.priority use participant-neutral wording covering the current target set. Updated the matching checked-in Goal SVG tooltips as generated-diagram companions to the authoritative XML fix.
source_changes: source/goal/structuredefinition-Goal.xml: changed Goal acceptance wording from individual-only/typo text to participant-neutral wording, including the current individual, organization, care team, and group target semantics.
source/goal/goal.svg: updated matching participant and status tooltip text to stay consistent with the authoritative Goal StructureDefinition change.
